程序包 org.bukkit.inventory.view.builder

接口 InventoryViewBuilder<V extends InventoryView>

类型参数:
V - 通过此构建器创建的 InventoryView 的类型

原文：the type of InventoryView created from this builder

所有已知子接口:
LocationInventoryViewBuilder<V>, MerchantInventoryViewBuilder<V>
@Experimental public interface InventoryViewBuilder<V extends InventoryView>
没有特殊属性或参数的通用 InventoryView 构建器

原文： Generic Builder for InventoryView's with no special attributes or parameters
